## Weekly Asset Returns (2023–2025) {#sec-data-returns-2025}

These data document weekly simple returns for 25 exchange-traded assets—individual
equities, a sector ETF, bond ETFs, and a commodity ETF—alongside a contemporaneous
weekly risk-free rate, covering the period September 30, 2023 to September 29, 2025. Prices
are sourced from Yahoo Finance and converted to weekly simple returns using
split- and dividend-adjusted closing prices. The dataset supports analysis of asset
pricing and portfolio diversification: the companion script estimates the Capital
Asset Pricing Model for each security and examines mean-variance tradeoffs across
asset classes and holding-period horizons.

The data ship as two files. `returns.csv` contains the weekly returns and the
risk-free rate only. `returns_prices.csv` contains the identical rows plus the
weekly adjusted closing price for every asset, in columns named `<ticker>_price`
(with SPY's price as `market_price`); it supports exercises that contrast price
levels with returns, such as the Ford-versus-Tesla comparison in the transformations
chapter of the course notes.

**Provenance.** Adjusted daily closing prices were retrieved from Yahoo Finance via
the `tidyquant` R package. The data request covers September 30, 2023 to
September 29, 2025 (`start_date` and `end_date` as set in `data_extract.R`). The risk-free rate is proxied by the
13-week U.S. Treasury bill secondary-market yield (`^IRX`), converted from an
annualized percentage to a weekly decimal rate by dividing by 100 and then by 52;
forward-filling patches any holiday gaps in that series. Price columns in
`returns_prices.csv` record the last available split- and dividend-adjusted daily
close on or before each weekly return date, so prices and returns are aligned on
the same Friday grid. Yahoo Finance terms of use
restrict redistribution of raw price data; this assembled dataset is intended for
educational use. See @returns-2025 for retrieval details.

### Variables {.unnumbered}

| Variable | Type | Unit / Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `date` | Discrete (date) | YYYY-MM-DD | End-of-week date corresponding to the Friday close used by `tq_transmute()` with `period = "weekly"`. |
| `market` | Continuous | proportion | Weekly simple return on SPY (SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust); renamed from `SPY` to signal its role as the market-portfolio proxy in CAPM estimation. |
| `AAPL` … `VCIT` (24 columns) | Continuous | proportion | Weekly simple return for each individual asset; one column per ticker. Column names match the Yahoo Finance ticker symbol. See @tbl-tickers-returns-2025 for descriptions. |
| `rf` | Derived (continuous) | proportion | Weekly risk-free rate, computed as `(^IRX / 100) / 52` from the annualized 13-week T-bill yield. |
| `market_price`, `AAPL_price` … `VCIT_price` (25 columns, `returns_prices.csv` only) | Continuous | USD | Split- and dividend-adjusted closing price on each weekly return date (last available daily close on or before the date). `market_price` is the SPY price. |

### Tickers {.unnumbered}

The 24 individual-asset columns span equities, airlines, and fixed-income and
commodity ETFs. The table below gives a brief description and a link to the ticker's
profile page.

| Ticker | Full name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`AAPL`](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/AAPL) | Apple Inc. | Equity | Consumer electronics, software, and services company; one of the largest publicly traded firms by market capitalization. |
| [`AMZN`](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/AMZN) | Amazon.com, Inc. | Equity | E-commerce and cloud computing (AWS) conglomerate; operates across retail, logistics, and digital services. |
| [`GOOG`](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/GOOG) | Alphabet Inc. (Class C) | Equity | Parent company of Google; generates revenue primarily from digital advertising, cloud services, and hardware. |
| [`MSTR`](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/MSTR) | Strategy Inc. | Equity | Business intelligence software company; holds a large Bitcoin treasury, making its stock returns highly sensitive to cryptocurrency prices. |
| [`NVDA`](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/NVDA) | NVIDIA Corporation | Equity | Designer of graphics processing units (GPUs) and AI accelerators; primary supplier of chips for large-scale machine learning workloads. |
| [`TSLA`](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/TSLA) | Tesla, Inc. | Equity | Electric vehicle and clean-energy company; high-growth, high-volatility stock with a large retail investor following. |
| [`BRK-A`](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/BRK-A) | Berkshire Hathaway Class A | Equity | Diversified holding company managed by Warren Buffett; subsidiaries span insurance, rail, energy, and consumer goods. Very high per-share price; otherwise economically identical to BRK-B. |
| [`BRK-B`](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/BRK-B) | Berkshire Hathaway Class B | Equity | 1/1500th economic interest in Berkshire Hathaway relative to Class A; more accessible price point, slightly different voting rights. |
| [`JPM`](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/JPM) | JPMorgan Chase & Co. | Equity | Largest U.S. bank by assets; operates commercial banking, investment banking, and asset management divisions. |
| [`PG`](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/PG) | Procter & Gamble Co. | Equity | Multinational consumer staples manufacturer (Tide, Pampers, Gillette); a canonical low-beta defensive stock. |
| [`WMT`](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/WMT) | Walmart Inc. | Equity | World's largest retailer by revenue; considered a defensive consumer-staples name despite its discretionary product mix. |
| [`XOM`](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/XOM) | Exxon Mobil Corporation | Equity | Integrated oil-and-gas major; returns are sensitive to crude oil prices and thus provide partial commodity exposure within an equity portfolio. |
| [`BA`](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/BA) | The Boeing Company | Equity | Commercial and defense aerospace manufacturer; subject to idiosyncratic risk from aircraft certification and production delays. |
| [`CAT`](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/CAT) | Caterpillar Inc. | Equity | Leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment; returns are cyclically sensitive to global infrastructure spending. |
| [`F`](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/F) | Ford Motor Company | Equity | Legacy U.S. automaker; investing in electric vehicle transition while managing legacy internal-combustion operations. |
| [`TGT`](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/TGT) | Target Corporation | Equity | U.S. general-merchandise retailer; operates roughly 2,000 stores and competes directly with Walmart in consumer staples and discretionary categories. |
| [`AAL`](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/AAL) | American Airlines Group | Equity — airline | One of the world's largest airlines by passenger volume; carries substantial long-term debt from pandemic-era borrowing. |
| [`ALK`](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/ALK) | Alaska Air Group, Inc. | Equity — airline | Regional U.S. carrier focused on the Pacific Coast; acquired Hawaiian Airlines in 2024. |
| [`DAL`](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/DAL) | Delta Air Lines, Inc. | Equity — airline | Major U.S. carrier; generally regarded as one of the more financially stable legacy airlines. |
| [`LUV`](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/LUV) | Southwest Airlines Co. | Equity — airline | Low-cost U.S. carrier with a historically differentiated point-to-point route model; underwent significant strategic changes in 2024–2025. |
| [`UAL`](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/UAL) | United Airlines Holdings | Equity — airline | Major U.S. carrier with extensive international network; high revenue and cost exposure to fuel prices. |
| [`GLD`](https://www.etf.com/GLD) | SPDR Gold Shares | ETF — commodity | Largest physically backed gold ETF; holds gold bullion in trust, providing direct exposure to gold spot prices without futures roll costs. |
| [`JNK`](https://www.etf.com/JNK) | SPDR Bloomberg High Yield Bond ETF | ETF — fixed income | Tracks an index of U.S. dollar-denominated high-yield (below investment grade) corporate bonds; higher credit risk and yield than investment-grade bond ETFs. |
| [`VCIT`](https://www.etf.com/VCIT) | Vanguard Intermediate-Term Corporate Bond ETF | ETF — fixed income | Tracks investment-grade U.S. corporate bonds with maturities of 5–10 years; lower credit risk than JNK but sensitive to interest-rate movements. |
| [`XLK`](https://www.etf.com/XLK) | Technology Select Sector SPDR Fund | ETF — sector | Tracks the technology sector of the S&P 500 (software, hardware, semiconductors); heavily concentrated in Apple and NVIDIA. |
